advisory.summary: Out-of-bounds read in golang.org/x/text/language when parsing a malformed language tag, causing panic (DoS). Affects versions < 0.3.7. Aliases: CVE-2021-38561, GHSA-ppp9-7jff-5vj2.

acquisition.notes: Minimal HTTP handler that passes an untrusted Accept-Language header value directly to language.Parse from golang.org/x/text@v0.3.6 (vulnerable). Attacker-controlled input reaches the vulnerable symbol on every request.

expected_verdict.label: exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: The vulnerable symbol language.Parse is called directly on an attacker-controlled HTTP header value with no sanitisation, on golang.org/x/text@v0.3.6 (< fixed 0.3.7). A crafted malformed language tag causes an out-of-bounds read and panic. The taint path from HTTP ingress to vulnerable call is trivial and direct. A canary/side-effect should be observable once F3 (sandbox) is real. Advisory verified against osv.dev on 2026-06-02.
